abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Roll 2d10, unopposed. Choose one ally within 4 units. That ally gains 1 free die on its next Action before the start of your next Turn.

abilities.name: Emergency Cover
abilities.text: When an ally within 3 units would suffer a Wound, grant that ally 1 Temporary Wound before the Wound is resolved. This Reaction cannot be used if the Support is unable to detect the ally.

system.gmNotes:
Role use. The Mook itself is fragile; its value comes from making another enemy more efficient. Players who identify and remove it should feel the encounter become easier.

Starting Enemy Example (Essence v0.6, Part XIV). Playtest reference; change its fictional presentation freely.
